title: bus_client-is-its-own-tool-not-a-lodger-in-the-gates-component
why: cairn/tools/determinism's test_q has read RED since 2026-08-31 ('A GATE CONSULTS AN ORACLE: cairn/tools/base'): the gate tool's directory holds the bus client that dials the inference host. Akien's 2026-08-13 ruling ('NO GATES MAY CONSULT ORACLES EVER PERIOD') is the why, and the lived symptom is a nine-day deterministic red that CC walked past on every `cairn test` — exactly the plaster CLAUDE.md forbids (a deterministic red is fixed or carries a ruling, never a paragraph).
how: git mv cairn/tools/base/bus_client.py to cairn/tools/bus_client/bus_client.py with a charter (intention+why.json — the why is the device isolation ruling of 2026-08-31 that bore it), rewrite the 11 importers (`from cairn.tools.base.bus_client import` -> `from cairn.tools.bus_client.bus_client import`), keep a proof beside it that its three faces (connect_bus, reach, connect_system) resolve a shim from disk, and re-run cairn/tools/determinism/proofs/test_determinism.py — test_q is the tooth and must read `base` as PURE or MOSTLY with gates >= 1.
traces_to: Akien's ruling 2026-08-13, 'NO GATES MAY CONSULT ORACLES EVER PERIOD', enforced by the determinism walk (Law 4 — this is physics that is red); CLAUDE.md's rule that a deterministic red is fixed or carries a ruling, never a paragraph.
falsifier: DONE when test_q_the_real_corpus_has_gates_and_not_one_consults_an_oracle passes, `base` shows no llm edge in the determinism report, and the 11 importers resolve (python3 -c import of each). WRONG INTENT if the sieve's component granularity is itself the defect — a gate should be judged on the gate module's own closure — in which case ticket 675ab0daa171's import-closure shape applies here and the move is cosmetic. My read: the move is right regardless, because `base` is a bag of unrelated primitives and a bus reacher never belonged in the gate's directory.
constraints: A move, not a sieve change: the determinism walk's component granularity is by design and stays.
The new tool needs intention+why.json in the same act or it does not run.
11 importers rewrite and are RUN, not grepped (sole-path residue: a subprocess or dynamic import is invisible to grep).
The determinism proof is reproved explicitly after the move — the reseal hook only sees staged files.
